description.en: Buy fruit and vegetables from mama mboga, ask for a kilo or a heap, bargain politely and shop by colour and size.
description.so: Ka iibso miro iyo khudaar mama mboga, weydii kiilo ama raso, si edeb leh u gorgortan, oo wax ku iibso midab iyo cabbir.

body.en: Mama mboga is the woman who sells vegetables from a small stall near your home. She knows her regular customers by name and may add a tomato or some dhania (coriander) for free. Produce is sold by the kilo or by the fungu, a small heap with a fixed price.
body.so: Mama mboga waa haweeneyda khudaarta ka iibisa miis yar oo gurigaaga u dhow. Macaamiisheeda joogtada ah magacooda ayay taqaannaa, waxaana laga yaabaa inay kuu dheer siiso yaanyo ama caleen dhania ah bilaash. Khudaarta waxaa lagu iibiyaa kiilo ama fungu, oo ah raso yar oo qiimo go'an leh.

examples.en: Give me half a kilo of tomatoes.
examples.so: Nus kiilo oo yaanyo ah i sii.

body.en: In open markets and with hawkers, bargaining is normal; in supermarkets and most dukas prices are fixed. Stay friendly. Ask Ni bei ya mwisho? (Is that the final price?), use Punguza kidogo from the numbers unit, offer a price with Nitakupa... (I'll give you...), and if it doesn't work, say Nitarudi baadaye and walk on.
body.so: Suuqyada furan iyo iibiyeyaasha wareega, gorgortanku waa caadi; suuqyada waaweyn iyo dukaamada intooda badan qiimuhu waa go'an yahay. Saaxiibtinimo muuji. Weydii Ni bei ya mwisho? (Kani ma qiimaha ugu dambeeyaa?), isticmaal Punguza kidogo oo aad ka baratay cutubka tirooyinka, qiimo ku soo jeedi Nitakupa... (Waxaan ku siinayaa...), haddii aysan suurtoobinna dheh Nitarudi baadaye oo iska soco.

examples.en: Lower it a little, I'll give you two hundred.
examples.so: Wax yar ka dhim, laba boqol ayaan ku siinayaa.

body.en: Colour words come after the noun: kofia nyeusi (a black cap). Red, black and white change with the noun: nguo nyekundu (red clothes) but shati jekundu (a red shirt), shati jeusi, shati jeupe. Kijani (green), njano (yellow) and bluu (blue) never change, and you often hear rangi ya... (the colour of...). Many Kenyans also just use English colour words.
body.so: Erayada midabku waxay yimaadaan magaca kadib: kofia nyeusi (koofiyad madow). Casaan, madow iyo cad way isbeddelaan iyadoo loo eegayo magaca: nguo nyekundu (dhar casaan ah) laakiin shati jekundu (shaati casaan ah), shati jeusi, shati jeupe. Kijani (cagaar), njano (jaale) iyo bluu (buluug) marna isma beddelaan, badanaana waxaad maqlaysaa rangi ya... (midabka...). Kenyaan badan waxay sidoo kale isticmaalaan erayada midabka ee Ingiriisiga.

body.en: Kubwa (big) and ndogo (small) also change their start to match the noun: mtoto mdogo (a small child), kitu kikubwa (a big thing), but nguo kubwa (big clothes). In a shop, Kenyans say saizi for size. Bring your own bag: Kenya banned plastic carrier bags in 2017.
body.so: Kubwa (weyn) iyo ndogo (yar) bilowgooda ayaa isbeddela si ay ula jaanqaadaan magaca: mtoto mdogo (ilmo yar), kitu kikubwa (wax weyn), laakiin nguo kubwa (dhar weyn). Dukaanka, Kenyaanku cabbirka waxay ugu yeeraan saizi. Bacdaada wado: Kenya waxay mamnuucday bacaha caagga ah sannadkii 2017.

note.en: Adding -ni to a place means 'at, in or to' it: soko → sokoni.
note.so: Ku darista -ni meel waxay ka dhigan tahay 'ku, gudaha ama u': soko → sokoni.
Macnaha erayga waa 'hooyada khudaarta'. Ugu yeer Mama.

note.en: In Kenya mboga is anything you eat with ugali, even meat or fish.
note.so: Kenya, mboga waa wax kasta oo ugali lala cuno, xitaa hilib ama kalluun.

note.en: Same word as nyanya (grandmother). The context makes it clear.
note.so: Waa isla erayga nyanya (ayeeyo). Xaaladda ayaa caddaysa.

note.en: One onion is kitunguu. Garlic is kitunguu saumu.
note.so: Hal basal waa kitunguu. Toonta waa kitunguu saumu.

note.en: In Nairobi you will also hear waru, from Gikuyu.
note.so: Nairobi sidoo kale waxaad maqli doontaa waru, oo ka timid luqadda Gikuyu.

note.en: Tomatoes and onions are often sold in small heaps with one price. Two heaps: mafungu mawili.
note.so: Yaanyada iyo basasha badanaa waxaa lagu iibiyaa raso yaryar oo hal qiimo leh. Laba raso: mafungu mawili.

items.en: Give me one kilo of oranges
items.so: Hal kiilo oo liin macaan ah i sii

note.en: A customer says this to get a little extra for free. A seller says it to ask you to raise your offer.
note.so: Macmiilku wuxuu yiraahdaa si uu wax yar oo dheeraad ah bilaash ugu helo. Iibiyuhu wuxuu yiraahdaa si uu kaaga codsado inaad qiimaha kordhiso.

items.so: Goor dambe ayaan soo noqon doonaa

note.en: Una chenji? = Do you have change? Small sellers often don't, so carry coins or use M-Pesa.
note.so: Una chenji? = Baaqi ma haysaa? Iibiyeyaasha yaryar badanaa ma haystaan, ee qaado qadaadiic ama isticmaal M-Pesa.

note.en: Changes with some nouns: shati jekundu (a red shirt).
note.so: Magacyada qaar ayuu la isbeddelaa: shati jekundu (shaati casaan ah).

note.en: Also manjano. Often rangi ya njano.
note.so: Sidoo kale manjano. Badanaa rangi ya njano.

note.en: Often rangi ya kijani (lit. the colour of a leaf).
note.so: Badanaa rangi ya kijani (macnaha erayga: midabka caleenta).

note.en: The formal school word is samawati, but Kenyans say bluu.
note.so: Erayga rasmiga ah ee iskuulka waa samawati, laakiin Kenyaanku waxay yiraahdaan bluu.

note.en: Changes with the noun: mtoto mdogo (a small child), kitu kidogo (a small thing).
note.so: Wuu isbeddelaa iyadoo loo eegayo magaca: mtoto mdogo (ilmo yar), kitu kidogo (wax yar).

note.en: Saizi is the everyday word for size.
note.so: Saizi waa erayga maalinlaha ah ee cabbirka.

note.en: Plastic carrier bags are banned in Kenya, so shoppers carry cloth bags or a kiondo.
note.so: Bacaha caagga ah Kenya waa laga mamnuucay, sidaas darteed dukaameystayaashu waxay qaataan bac maro ah ama kiondo.

meaning.en: I'm going to the market to buy vegetables.
meaning.so: Suuqa ayaan u socdaa si aan khudaar u iibsado.

explain.en: 'Welcome, madam! What are you buying today?' – 'I'm buying vegetables.'
explain.so: 'Soo dhowow, hooyo! Maanta maxaad iibsanaysaa?' – 'Khudaar ayaan iibsanayaa.'

explain.en: 'What do you want, madam?' – 'Tomatoes and onions.'

meaning.en: Give me potatoes and carrots, please.
meaning.so: Baradho iyo karooto i sii, fadlan.

explain.en: 'The mangoes are very sweet today!' – 'Okay, give me five.' Matano is five for ma- words like maembe.
explain.so: 'Cambuhu maanta aad bay u macaan yihiin!' – 'Hagaag, shan i sii.' Matano waa shan marka ay la socoto erayada ma- sida maembe.

meaning.so: Waxaan jeclahay liin macaan iyo muus.

lines.sw: Habari, mama mboga! Fungu moja la nyanya ni ngapi?
lines.en: Hello, mama mboga! How much is one heap of tomatoes?
lines.so: Iska warran, mama mboga! Hal raso oo yaanyo ah waa immisa?

lines.sw: Nipe mafungu mawili, na nusu kilo ya viazi.
lines.en: Give me two heaps, and half a kilo of potatoes.
lines.so: Laba raso i sii, iyo nus kiilo oo baradho ah.

lines.sw: Sawa. Ni mia moja na hamsini.
lines.en: Okay. That's one hundred and fifty.

question.en: How much is one heap of tomatoes?
question.so: Hal raso oo yaanyo ah waa immisa?

explain.en: 'How many kilos do you want?' – 'Two kilos, please.'

lines.sw: Kilo moja ni mia moja na hamsini.
lines.en: One kilo is one hundred and fifty.
lines.so: Hal kiilo waa boqol iyo konton.

lines.sw: Ni bei ya mwisho? Punguza kidogo.
lines.en: Is that the final price? Lower it a little.
lines.so: Kani ma qiimaha ugu dambeeyaa? Wax yar ka dhim.

question.en: What price do they agree on?

explain.en: 'The price is three hundred.' – 'Is that the final price?'
explain.so: 'Qiimuhu waa saddex boqol.' – 'Kani ma qiimaha ugu dambeeyaa?'

meaning.en: I don't have change. I'll come back later.
meaning.so: Baaqi ma haysto. Goor dambe ayaan soo noqon doonaa.

explain.en: 'Which colour do you like?' – 'I like blue.'

lines.so: Soo dhowow! Ma ku caawin karaa?

lines.sw: Naangalia tu. Kuna saizi kubwa zaidi?
lines.en: I'm just looking. Is there a bigger size?
lines.so: Waan eegayaa uun. Ma jiraa cabbir ka weyn?

lines.en: Yes. Do you want black or white?
lines.so: Haa. Ma madow baad rabtaa mise cad?

lines.en: Here it is. Do you want a bag?

explain.en: 'Can I help you?' – 'I'm just looking, thanks.'
explain.so: 'Ma ku caawin karaa?' – 'Waan eegayaa uun, mahadsanid.'
